purpose: Draft row-level audit template for graph/external-label C2T rows after B Round1 and INSPECTOR B Round1 warning. This template is for future row audit only and does not perform PI synthesis or material validation.

forbidden_or_not_used_inputs: material-validation sources outside the authorized bundle
input_scope.inspection_warning_carried_forward: References from B Round1 to C2_round3_external_label_schema.csv and C2T_source_inventory.csv remain unverified in this inspection scope and must not be treated as audited evidence here.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Unique joined-table row key, separate from sample_id and not derived from target labels.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Stable row identifier exists and is reproducible from the predeclared join table.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Same-sample key shared by structure, graph features, controls, labels, finite-size metadata, and batch/family fields.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Defined before label inspection and not based on material name alone, target value, or post-label filtering.
hard_fail_if: cross-source name match without structure_id/snapshot_id evidence
encodes target value or target class

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Human-readable material/composition key used only as a secondary crosswalk descriptor.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Can support review of sample_id but cannot substitute for sample_id.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Stable structure or model identifier for graph/OI computation.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Traceable to the same structure_or_SI_source row used to compute graph features.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Atomic snapshot, averaging window, or declared static-structure scope.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Matches the graph features and is temporally compatible with the external label or explicitly declared as a justified matched-structure row.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Auditable structure file, SI table/figure, or model source path/DOI.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Contains enough species, periodic cell, finite-size, and geometry/orbital metadata for graph construction or declares row blocked.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: DOI/table/figure/SI/path plus row or digitized point id for the external label.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Tied to the same sample_id and not generated by the graph proxy.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Numeric value, unit, label name, method, temperature, direction/class if applicable, and source type for Hall/Drude/Wannier/spectral labels.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Value and unit are explicit; method and source are external to graph feature generation.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Boolean preventing graph-generated or proxy-fit labels from being treated as external validation.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: true for any material-validation candidate row.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Row-level flag for synthetic, generated, diagnostic, or graph-derived labels.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: false for material-validation candidates; true rows remain diagnostic only.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Distinguishes real material row, cross-source matched row, baseline-context-only row, and synthetic diagnostic row.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: same_sample_material or explicitly justified declared_matched_structure_material is required before material_validation_allowed may be true.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Pre-label lock for graph cutoff, weighting, Laplacian, budget normalization, attack protocol, and seed policy.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Timestamp/version/protocol id predates label reading and is shared by all G1_* fields in the row.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Rule for edges and weights, including required geometry/orbital inputs.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Declared before labels are read and computable from structure_or_SI_source.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Primary graph metric under locked normalized Laplacian convention.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Computed from the same structure_id/snapshot_id with L_sym explicitly locked.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Budget-normalized weighted adjacency spectral radius.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Raw rho is accompanied by the predeclared budget-normalization rule; raw unnormalized rho alone fails.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Targeted-vs-matched-random lambda2 attack gap.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Targeted removal, matched random weakening, removed-budget accounting, and seed policy are all recorded.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Exact Srivastava O_s or explicitly locked executable surrogate baseline.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Exact normalization or surrogate status is fixed before graph-vs-baseline claims.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Independent onsite-variance control or declared missingness.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Source is independent of target Wannier label generation.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Independent carrier-density value with unit and method.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Not algebraically inverted from the same Hall/Drude target measurement.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Independent mobility-edge margin or declared missingness.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Not extracted from the same spectral fit as the target.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Atom count, cell size, snapshot window, or model-size descriptor.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Sufficient to audit finite-size graph artifacts.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Synthesis batch, structure family, literature family, or held-out blocking key.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: Defined independently of target outcomes and usable for leakage/family split checks.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Row-level result covering carrier density, onsite variance, mobility-edge margin, batch/family key, synthetic labels, and graph-generated labels.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: All forbidden-control checks pass with explicit provenance notes.

audit_template_fields.audit_role: Derived final gate, not manually asserted.
audit_template_fields.pass_requirement: true only if all required fields pass, same-sample crosswalk passes, graph convention lock passes, forbidden-control audit passes, synthetic_label_flag=false, and material_source_flag is material-valid.

same_sample_crosswalk_tests.name: pre_label_sample_key_lock
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.question: Was sample_id created and versioned before reading or fitting target labels?
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.pass_condition: sample_id_creation_record exists and predates label_provenance_id extraction.

same_sample_crosswalk_tests.name: structure_label_identity
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.question: Does sample_id bridge material_id, structure_id, snapshot_id_or_window, label_provenance_id, controls, and graph features?
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.pass_condition: All row entities map through a documented crosswalk; material name or composition alone is insufficient.

same_sample_crosswalk_tests.name: cross_source_mismatch_screen
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.question: For cross-source candidates, are synthesis/processing comparability, temporal/sample match, temperature, carrier-density compatibility, and family key audited?
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.pass_condition: Every mismatch dimension is marked pass or row is explicitly downgraded to blocked_join_candidate.

same_sample_crosswalk_tests.name: snapshot_window_compatibility
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.question: Does the graph snapshot/window correspond to the label measurement scope or a declared matched-structure scope?
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.pass_condition: snapshot_id_or_window is present and compatibility rationale is recorded before label modeling.

same_sample_crosswalk_tests.name: family_batch_leakage_key
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.question: Is B0_batch_or_family defined without target information and suitable for held-out or leakage audit?
same_sample_crosswalk_tests.pass_condition: Family/batch key is present and not post-selected on label behavior.

graph_convention_lock_tests.name: graph_protocol_precedes_labels
graph_convention_lock_tests.pass_condition: graph_convention_provenance_id was fixed before label_provenance_id values were read, digitized, or fit.

graph_convention_lock_tests.name: Lsym_lambda2_lock
graph_convention_lock_tests.pass_condition: G1_lambda2_Lsym uses normalized Laplacian L_sym with the exact convention documented.

graph_convention_lock_tests.name: weighted_adjacency_budget_normalization
graph_convention_lock_tests.pass_condition: G1_rho_A_budget_norm records weighted adjacency A_w, raw rho if used, normalization budget, and budget rule.

graph_convention_lock_tests.name: attack_gap_matched_random_control
graph_convention_lock_tests.pass_condition: G1_attack_gap_lambda2 records targeted attack, matched random weakening, removed-budget accounting, random seed policy, and number of repeats if stochastic.

graph_convention_lock_tests.name: same_graph_row_consistency
graph_convention_lock_tests.pass_condition: All G1_* metrics are computed from the same structure_id, snapshot_id_or_window, graph_cutoff_rule, and graph_convention_provenance_id.

synthetic_label_flag_logic: Set true for any synthetic, generated, graph-proxy-produced, simulated diagnostic, or target-fit-derived label.
A true value forces material_validation_allowed=false regardless of field completeness.
Synthetic rows may be used only for software plumbing, schema testing, and diagnostic calculations.
material_source_flag_logic: same_sample_material requires auditable same-sample structure-label-control crosswalk.

declared_matched_structure_material requires explicit mismatch audit and predeclared matching rationale; it is still blocked unless all same-sample crosswalk tests pass under the declared matched-scope rule.
baseline_context_only can support O_s or m_eff baseline context but cannot support graph material validation by itself.
cross_source_candidate_blocked covers Jankousky plus Furubayashi or Srivastava plus Furubayashi style joins until a crosswalk survives audit.

must_check_per_row.fail_if: B0_onsite_variance is computed from the target Wannier Hamiltonian or the same target-generating fit.
B0_carrier_density is algebraically inverted from the same Hall/Drude measurement used as the target.
B0_mobility_edge_margin is extracted from the same spectral fit or fitted feature used as the target.
B0_batch_or_family is chosen after inspecting target labels or encodes target class/value.
external_Hall_Drude_Wannier_spectral_label is generated by the graph proxy, same target fit, or synthetic process.
A required B0/G1/label field is absent without declared missingness and blocker status.

minimum_audit_record.provenance_notes: required for every pass or not_applicable result

material_validation_allowed_true_if_all: all required audit_template_fields are present or have an allowed explicit missingness state where the schema permits it
same_sample_crosswalk_tests all pass under same_sample_material or declared matched-structure rules
material_source_flag is same_sample_material or audited declared_matched_structure_material
external_label_payload has numeric value, unit, method, temperature/scope where relevant, and label_provenance_id
O_s_or_exact_overlap_baseline is exact or the surrogate baseline is locked before any graph-vs-baseline claim
hard_fail_conditions: sample_id missing, target-derived, or constructed after label inspection
structure_or_SI_source missing for graph metric rows
label_provenance_id missing or not row-level auditable
graph_convention_provenance_id missing or selected after label inspection
G1_lambda2_Lsym not using locked L_sym convention
G1_rho_A_budget_norm supplied only as raw unnormalized rho
G1_attack_gap_lambda2 lacks matched random attack or removed-budget accounting
forbidden_control_audit missing, failed, or blocked by missing provenance
B0_onsite_variance, B0_carrier_density, or B0_mobility_edge_margin derived from the target-generating measurement or fit
B0_finite_size or B0_batch_or_family missing for rows claiming graph metric comparison
diagnostic_only_conditions: baseline_context_only rows without computable same-sample graph rows
external_label_candidate_only rows without same-sample structure graph

remaining_blockers.blocker: No stable same-sample crosswalk tying structure, controls, graph features, and external labels.
No raw structure bundle or SI row with structure_id/snapshot_id sufficient for graph computation in current candidate rows.
Graph conventions for L_sym, budget-normalized rho_A, and attack gap are schema-defined but not row-computable for material validation.
Row-level forbidden-control audit is absent and cannot be inferred from schema presence.
Carrier density, onsite variance, mobility-edge margin, finite-size descriptor, and batch/family key remain missing or leakage-prone for candidate material rows.
Synthetic and graph-generated labels may test plumbing only and must not be upgraded to material validation.
C2_round3_external_label_schema.csv and C2T_source_inventory.csv were cited in B Round1 but not re-audited in the permitted Inspector B bundle.

allowed_claims: A row-level audit template exists for future graph/external-label joined rows.
Current candidate rows remain blocked or diagnostic-only under the reviewed bundle.
No material-validation row is upgraded by this Round2 template.
forbidden_claims: graph metrics beat O_s or other baselines
external labels have been fully audited from unreviewed source-inventory files
forbidden controls have been eliminated for any material row
claim_boundary.short_form: synthetic rows diagnostic only; row-level template ready; no material validation
